content.comment_body: I receive the attached error when trying to deploy to AWS using [product_name].
Hello, I am encountering the same issue. Please watch the video at [url].
Hello, I also have this issue. Maybe it's necessary to open the environment directly in AWS?
I tried that. See the video at minute 2:10.

Here's what I've done: Go to AWS and navigate to Elastic Beanstalk. Select 'create a new environment,' then choose a virtual server. Enter a name for your application and the environment. Next, select TOMCAT 8.5 with 'Java 8 running on 64-bit Amazon Linux.' Confirm to proceed, and AWS creates the environment. If successful, in [product_name], deploy on AWS selecting an existing environment and refresh if the link isn't visible. Not sure if AWS will charge for this. It works, but I'm wondering if this is the recommended approach.
Could someone post a video tutorial?
I followed your instructions exactly, but when starting, I get a 502 Bad Gateway error from nginx / 1.18.0.
Hi, I'm unable to make a video but I am sending some images. The content is in Italian.

After 15 days from registration, I received an email from AWS: Dear AWS Customer, Thank you for using Amazon Web Services! You recently requested an AWS Service that required additional validation. Your request is now validated for AWS Europe (Frankfurt) regions. If you still have troubles, please reach out. Everything works fine now and I'm pleased with the result.
I am still encountering the same error. [user_name]'s solution helped me fix the issue.

Did you receive an email from AWS? Dear AWS Customer, Thank you for using Amazon Web Services! You recently requested an AWS Service that required additional validation. Your request has now been validated for AWS Europe (Frankfurt) region(s). If you need help, please contact aws-verification@amazon.com. After receiving this, everything worked as instructed.
Hello, our team is aware of this issue. You can find a workaround at [url]. Regards, Tech Support
Hello, could someone share how they solved this? I get the same error. Do you just wait for AWS to send the notification about the error? Thanks.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-language forum; please use English for your next post. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members consistently encounter errors when deploying [product_name] solutions to AWS, even after following basic setup and configuration steps such as creating Elastic Beanstalk environments. Persistent issues like the '502 Bad Gateway' suggest deployment or infrastructure configuration hurdles, compounded by limited clear guidance. Ultimately, successful deployment occurred only after receiving an AWS validation email, which highlighted the importance of waiting for external service activation and procedural confirmations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple, error-free deployment process for [product_name] applications on AWS, supported by clear error messages and accessible troubleshooting materials, including official video tutorials and documentation.
